actual_scope: Actual bound r04 module loading, first closed receipt/assessment and bound allocated/process/contract/raw metadata per method; exact current table headers. No real full release verification, no main/close, no real CSV write.
changes: Calls unchanged full run_navigation_n05.verify_release before projection and on recovery/repeat; independently reviewed r04 validator loaded from exact5554ddf0 SHA.
Requires ledger stage/count, exact ordered24 tuples equal design/prepared/manager, bound design, consumed prefix/retired tail, no consumed after first infrastructure failure.

Validates every consumed receipt including failed ones; binds each administrative metadata input to original receipt and prepared contract SHA. Keeps failed errors/report references and all retired identities in closure.
Durable transaction directory is published atomically after6before/after snapshot files+manifest are individually fsynced and directory fsynced. No CSV replacement starts before this publication.

Each target must match recorded before/after SHA before any recovery write; unexpected historical edits, snapshot corruption or input changes reject. Temporary files are unique; abandoned staging cannot block retry.
Partial replacements roll forward from preserved snapshots; each replacement directory is fsynced. Complete closure appears through exclusive atomic hardlink after contents fsync.
Successful reentry compares current inputs, exact closure bytes and3after hashes then returns without table/journal/closure writes; verified unchanged hash,mtime,inode in fixture.
assumptions_and_limits: Root must be the sole writer of these three CSVs while this closure runs; fcntl serializes this implementation, not unrelated noncooperating writers.
Recovery deliberately requires frozen input/source hashes; it refuses new third table versions or changed receipts instead of guessing or overwriting.
This is administrative projection, not physics replay or new result assessment. Bad capture and physical/task negatives retain their identities.
ended_utc is receipt filesystem mtime sampled during planning and explicitly labeled; not exact process or physics terminal time.
Filesystem failure tests inject real local write/replace/link/fsync errors; they are not hardware power-loss testing.
The actual full release verifier was stubbed only in synthetic cases; runtime calls the unchanged real verifier. Root independent review is still required before the authorized projection.
